items.title: 61521_David Albert Francis oral history interview
items.q: I remember you brought me in on the Clyde Otis thing with Bedford Hendrix who made the arrangements, and we got to be like a demonstration group for Clyde Otis

ctx.x: And then you got me in on that gig, and I remember you brought me in on the Clyde Otis thing with Bedford Hendrix who made the arrangements, and we got to be like a demonstration group for Clyde Otis, and Clyde went to Mercury, and we were really in, and you being the drummer, you were the guy who was in -- I remember you really brought me into that.
So you go and tell about that whole era now. With that Clyde Otis era, the fifties, and it was Mercury records.
